text: Make the good habit easy to start and the bad one annoying to reach.
credit: Idea from Atomic Habits by James Clear

text: You cannot always choose your circumstances, but you can choose your stance toward them.
credit: Idea from Man's Search for Meaning by Viktor E. Frankl

text: Systems beat goals because they shape daily behavior long after motivation fades.
credit: Idea from Atomic Habits by James Clear

text: The ability to concentrate without distraction is becoming rare, which makes it increasingly valuable.
credit: Idea from Deep Work by Cal Newport

text: Deep work is a skill that must be trained, not a talent you either have or lack.
credit: Idea from Deep Work by Cal Newport

text: Your mind runs on fast intuition and slow reasoning; pause to engage the slower system when stakes rise.
credit: Idea from Thinking, Fast and Slow by Daniel Kahneman

text: Large groups cooperate because they believe in the same stories.
credit: Idea from Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind by Yuval Noah Harari

text: Some things gain from disorder; stress and volatility can make them stronger.
credit: Idea from Antifragile by Nassim Nicholas Taleb

text: A growth mindset turns failure into information, not a verdict on your fixed worth.
credit: Idea from Mindset by Carol Dweck

text: Treat every product as an experiment; measure what customers do, not what they promise.
credit: Idea from The Lean Startup by Eric Ries
